fusions.name: In the Traces
fusions.desc: Throws your harnessed weight into the target, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Herd Banner
fusions.desc: Plants a banner with a stamp that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Draught Harness
fusions.desc: Buckles on a draught harness, raising your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rested Caparison
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
